seal.statement: A preserved branch is never proven and its author is told the wrong thing. Since the non-main preservation fast path landed (79e8c7cb9 + 4c98b0a59) a push of only non-main branch refs skips the local gate, and ci.yml runs only on pushes to main and pull requests into main, so quest/, land/ and review/ branches (and the stacked PRs whose heads they are) carried reds nobody saw; ci.yml also still carries a dead '[ci:self-hosted]' commit-message route to a label only the offline GCP proof VM has, with a header claiming pull requests can never reach a self-hosted runner, which a pull request's own copy of the workflow can always do. Owner decisions 2026-10-04 (after the rejected preserved-branches-get-their-cone, which this supersedes; its findings and measurements stand by reference): D1 a push to quest/**, land/** or review/** runs ci.yml's change gate on a GitHub-hosted runner, proving the CONE of the pushed head against its merge-base with main (not before..after, not HEAD^), never the corpus: a cone the selector refuses fails the run by name (MODULAR PROOF NOT SAFE) exactly as for a pull request, and nothing the branch run reaches is a corpus entry point or main's structural analysis; a newer push to the same branch cancels the superseded run, while main's runs are never cancelled; main pushes and pull requests into main run the same steps against the same base as before; permissions stay contents: read. D2 wip/** and every other prefix stay free of CI. D3 the '[ci:self-hosted]' route is retired: ci.yml has no trigger, label or expression by which any event selects a runner other than a GitHub-hosted one (no pull_request_target), the resource plan names the literal hosted label, publish refuses --runner as a retired option with a clear message, action-authority no longer registers route-self-hosted-runner, and no tracked file outside quest history names the marker. D4 the pre-push fast path keeps exactly one line: for a push whose pushed branches a workflow's push trigger covers it names that workflow (ci.yml for the three prefixes, full-gate.yml for release-proof/**, release.yml for release-publishability/**); otherwise it says the push is unproven unless an open pull request into main covers it and gives the cone command with its precondition, from a clean checkout at <sha> (the first uncovered commit; with a count when several refs are uncovered); nothing for a main push, LAGRANGE_PUSH_PROVE_BRANCH or a deletion-only push; the hook's prefix list is bound by a witness to the prefixes derived from every workflow's parsed push trigger, and the runbook states the command's prerequisites (exact clean checkout, generated import graph).

text: D1-D4 implemented on d60c30921 (delta staged; the superseded quest's starting delta carried forward). ci.yml: push triggers main + quest/** land/** review/**; gate runs-on the literal ubuntu-24.04 (routing expression and its comment removed; header now states that a pull request runs its own copy of the file, so no expression could keep fork code off another runner); range step: pull_request -> PR base, refs/heads/main -> before (HEAD^ fallback unchanged), any other ref declares no LAGRANGE_CHECK_BASE so scripts/checks/changed-paths.js resolvedCheckRange uses the publication merge-base with origin/main (fetch-depth 0 fetches every branch, origin/main included; the step fails if origin/main is absent); concurrency cancel-in-progress = ref != refs/heads/main; structural analysis + health upload if github.ref == refs/heads/main (was != pull_request, which would have reached branch pushes). test/manifests/ci-resource-plan.json gate runsOn ubuntu-24.04. publish-head: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_MARKER, resolvePublishRunner and the headMessage read removed; --runner refused as retired; validatePublishRequest returns github; ciRunUrl queries --branch main (a branch run of the same sha would otherwise be reported). action-authority: route-self-hosted-runner action, its requires/because texts and decideRunnerRouting removed. .githooks/pre-push: REMOTE_PROOF_PREFIXES mirror (quest/ land/ review/ -> ci.yml, release-proof/ -> full-gate.yml, release-publishability/ -> release.yml); one line: 'remote proof - this push triggers <workflows> (results: gh run list --commit <sha>)' or 'unproven - no workflow runs on a push to <branch>, so nothing proves it unless an open pull request into main covers it; prove the cone from a clean checkout at <sha>: node scripts/lab.js test changed --lane all --split --sha <sha>[ (first of N unproven refs)]'. Witnesses in project-hardening-contracts, check-base-range, select-change-tests, pre-push-hook-control-flow; publish-head and action-authority tests updated.

Census after the change (B4). WHICH REFS GET A REMOTE PROOF: owner = each workflow's own on.push.branches / pull_request: ci.yml (main, quest/**, land/**, review/** push; PRs into main; dispatch), full-gate.yml (release-proof/**, dispatch), release.yml (release-publishability/**, v* tags), formation-health.yml (schedule), full-corpus-canary.yml (dispatch only). Mirrors, each bound by a witness: .githooks/pre-push REMOTE_PROOF_PREFIXES (pre-push-hook-control-flow derives the map from every workflow file), test/release/project-hardening-contracts.test.js (pins ci.yml's triggers), docs/development/solver-runbook.md (prose, unbound). Local proof: .githooks/pre-push ALL_NON_MAIN_BRANCH_REFS fast path (owner of the local gate). WHICH RUNNER: test/manifests/ci-resource-plan.json owns every job's runs-on (budget row ci_resources_not_plan_driven checks equality; contracts witness pins ci.yml/gate = the literal); no path in ci.yml selects anything but ubuntu-24.04. Remaining non-hosted labels: full-gate.yml/gate and formation-health.yml/health [self-hosted, gcp] behind their wake jobs (out of scope per D3). Retired: '[ci:self-hosted]' in ci.yml, ci-resource-plan, publish-head, runbook and the contracts/publish-head/action-authority tests; git grep finds it only in solve/quests history. CONSUMERS OF CI RUNS that now see branch runs: pre-push red-main guard (gh run list --workflow ci.yml --branch main: unaffected); publish-head ciRunUrl (was --commit only, now also --branch main); scripts/checks/hosted-gate-repeatability.js (counts every 'ci' run on the HEAD sha, any branch - a branch run of the same sha would count; probe of the deterministic-cloud-gate epic; recorded, not changed, R17); full-corpus-canary decide (dispatch only; its workflow_run guard already requires head_branch main). Remaining duplicates: the runbook's prose list of covered prefixes; hosted-gate-repeatability's branch-blind run filter.

Design limits stated plainly. (1) A branch with an open PR into main runs ci.yml twice (push ref and PR ref are different concurrency groups); deciding that needs an API call, which ci.yml does not make; accepted. (2) GitHub reads the workflow from the pushed commit: a quest/ land/ review/ branch whose tip predates this ci.yml gets no run, yet the hook says it triggers ci.yml (the hook reads only ref lines, tree none). (3) The refusal path is the PR path unchanged: npm run check -> select-change-tests refuses with MODULAR PROOF NOT SAFE <reason> and exit 1 and never widens; the push gate's FULL_CORPUS_TRIGGER_RULES (e.g. .githooks/) are consumed only by the local pre-push gate, so on a hosted branch run a .githooks/ change gets its cone, not the corpus, exactly as a PR does today. (4) Land blocker: solve land's epic-scope guard refuses solve/quests/preserved-branches-get-their-cone/** (outside this quest's dir and the epic's authorizes); measured with guards.epicScopeProblems. Precedent 5cccd1557 committed a superseded quest's record directly; that commit is a lead/owner action before land.
